# Wrap WETH

> Wrap WETH is the on-chain action of depositing native Ether into a wrapper contract and receiving ERC-20-compatible Wrapped Ether back, 1:1.

## Key facts
- Token: Wrapped Ether (WETH), an ERC-20 token with 18 decimals
- Backing / peg: 1 WETH = 1 ETH, redeemable through the wrapper contract
- Convert: Wrap via deposit(), unwrap via withdraw(amount)
- Networks: Network-specific WETH contracts; mainnet is chain ID 1
- Costs: No protocol conversion fee; network gas in ETH applies
- Verify: Check the contract address, not the ticker
